name: Goa
description: Explore beautiful beaches, Portuguese architecture, nightlife and delicious seafood in Goa.

travelInfo.transport: Goa is accessible by flight, train and bus.
travelInfo.airport: Manohar International Airport and Goa International Airport
travelInfo.localTransport: Rental bikes, taxis, auto-rickshaws and local buses.
travelInfo.tips: Book accommodation early during peak season and carry sunscreen.

name: Manali
description: Experience beautiful Himalayan mountains, snow-covered valleys and adventure activities.

travelInfo.transport: Manali can be reached by road from Delhi and Chandigarh. The nearest major railway station is Chandigarh.
travelInfo.localTransport: Local taxis, buses and rental bikes.
travelInfo.tips: Carry warm clothes, check weather conditions and verify road access before visiting high-altitude attractions.

name: Jaipur
description: Discover royal palaces, magnificent forts and traditional Rajasthani culture.

travelInfo.transport: Jaipur is well connected by flights, trains and buses.
travelInfo.localTransport: Metro, auto-rickshaws, taxis and city buses.
travelInfo.tips: Visit forts early in the morning and carry water while exploring historical sites.

name: Kerala
description: Enjoy peaceful backwaters, green tea gardens and beautiful natural landscapes.

travelInfo.transport: Kerala is accessible by flights, trains and buses.
travelInfo.airport: Cochin International Airport, Trivandrum International Airport and Calicut International Airport
travelInfo.localTransport: Taxis, buses, trains and boats in backwater regions.
travelInfo.tips: Carry light cotton clothes and book houseboat experiences in advance.

name: Paris
description: Explore romantic streets, iconic monuments and world-famous museums.

travelInfo.transport: Paris is accessible through international flights and European train networks.
travelInfo.airport: Charles de Gaulle Airport and Orly Airport
travelInfo.localTransport: Metro, buses, trams, taxis and regional trains.
travelInfo.tips: Keep your passport secure, check museum opening days and consider booking popular attractions in advance.

name: Bali
description: Discover tropical beaches, beautiful temples and scenic island landscapes.

travelInfo.transport: Bali is accessible through international flights.
travelInfo.localTransport: Rental scooters, taxis and private tour vehicles.
travelInfo.tips: Respect local temple customs, carry appropriate clothing for temple visits and check ferry schedules for island trips.
